body.prose:
A holon may carry a name of its own, beside its title: short and lowercase, made to be typed and written in an address, where the title is for reading. The name is the holon's, not given by whoever holds it, so it is the same in every whole that holds it, and each whole asks only that what it holds be unique by name. Two holons named `type` can stand in the field, never in one whole.

*The author's, 2026-11-04: a holon that has no name unless you know its parent is not very holon-like, not very autonomous; the holon earns the name. Unique among what one whole holds the session's, agreed by him.*
body.title: A holon is named by itself
